notes:
I can't give you the notes yet: I didn't manage to read any sources.

I tried to open five pages at once: Enduring Word on Isaiah 8, the Geneva Study Bible and Ellicott pages on StudyLight, Precept Austin's Isaiah 8 page, and Wesley's notes on Isaiah. My code failed while handling the results, before it showed me any page text. When I tried again, the tool said I had no calls left for this turn, so I couldn't search or open anything else.

Your rules say to report only what the pages say and give a URL for every point, so I haven't written anything from memory.

If you ask again, I'll start fresh and work through:
- **Traditional reading, verse by verse:** Enduring Word, plus Gill, Ellicott, the Pulpit Commentary and others on BibleHub and StudyLight, and Precept Austin.
- **Where traditions differ:** Wesley's notes, the Geneva notes, Spurgeon and others, especially on the "Immanuel" in v. 8, the stone of stumbling in vv. 14–15 (quoted in Romans 9 and 1 Peter 2), and "the children the LORD has given me" in v. 18 (quoted in Hebrews 2:13).
- **Other views:** NET Bible notes and Bible Odyssey for modern scholarship, and New Advent and catholic.com for Catholic readings. I'd include popular modern teaching only where those sites actually discuss it.

You'd get notes in the "v. 4: …" format with a URL after each point, leaving out anything I can't find.
